rank1_gate: LearnedRank1 mean tracking must be within 2% of full Local while using one fitted client coefficient.
rank2_gate: LearnedRank2 must not be worse than full Local while using two fitted client coefficients.
notes: Fresh finite-data personalized gate. Training clients send adaptive structured estimates and normalized covariance summaries. The server selects an unknown group count with the 9D heteroscedastic mixture and learns hard-group control-aware backbones from the transmitted estimates. An unseen client fits coefficients for every candidate backbone on its first three records, selects the group on its held-out complementary record, and refits only the selected r-dimensional coefficient on all records. OracleGroup variants use true labels only to attribute group-discovery loss. Local fits all three parameters on the same records. No true unseen-client parameter enters the proposed estimator.
